note: All prices are integer paise. price_paise is the unit price; never a float, never rupees.

products.name: Northwind Tempo 3 Road Running Shoe
products.description: A neutral daily trainer with a 8mm drop and a compression-moulded EVA midsole. Built for 5K to half-marathon distances on tarmac.

products.name: Northwind Tempo 3 Wide Fit
products.description: The Tempo 3 on a wider last, for runners who splay at the forefoot. Same midsole, same drop, 4mm extra across the toe box.

products.name: Northwind Ridge Trail Shoe
products.description: 4mm lugs on a sticky rubber outsole with a rock plate underfoot. For loose gravel, wet rock and hill trails.

products.name: Northwind Ridge GTX Waterproof
products.description: The Ridge with a waterproof membrane and a gusseted tongue. Made for monsoon trail running. Currently out of stock.

products.name: Northwind Sprint Racing Flat
products.description: A 184g race-day flat with a carbon plate and a firm foam. Fast, unforgiving, and not intended as a daily trainer.

products.name: Northwind Base Gym Trainer
products.description: A flat, stable sole for lifting and gym sessions. Not a running shoe — the midsole is deliberately firm.

products.name: Northwind Drift Recovery Slide
products.description: A soft foam slide to change into after a long run. Contoured footbed, one-piece upper.

products.name: Northwind Tempo 2 (Previous Season)
products.description: Last season's Tempo, discounted while stock lasts. Mechanically identical to the Tempo 3 apart from the upper mesh.

products.name: Northwind Merino Crew Sock
products.description: Merino blend crew sock with a cushioned heel. Warm without being bulky inside a running shoe.

products.name: Northwind Featherlight Ankle Sock 3-Pack
products.description: Three pairs of thin ankle socks with a mesh instep. Priced at exactly the free-shipping threshold.

products.name: Northwind Blister-Guard Sock
products.description: A double-layer sock that lets the two surfaces shear against each other instead of against your skin. One paise below the free-shipping threshold, deliberately.

products.name: Northwind Compression Calf Sleeve
products.description: Graduated compression from ankle to knee, worn during long efforts or after them.

products.name: Northwind Airflow Running Tee
products.description: A perforated polyester tee with flat seams under the arm. Dries fast in humidity.

products.name: Northwind Long Sleeve Base Layer
products.description: A thin thermal base layer with thumb loops, for early winter mornings.

products.name: Northwind 5-Inch Split Short
products.description: A split-hem short with a built-in liner and a zip pocket at the back of the waistband.

products.name: Northwind 7-Inch Training Short
products.description: A longer training short with two deep side pockets. Cut for gym work as much as running.

products.name: Northwind Thermal Running Tight
products.description: Brushed-inside tights with a zip ankle. Out of stock until the next winter drop.

products.name: Northwind Packable Wind Jacket
products.description: A 92g wind shell that folds into its own chest pocket. Wind resistant, not waterproof.

products.name: Northwind Monsoon Rain Shell
products.description: A taped-seam running shell with pit vents, rated for sustained rain rather than showers.

products.name: Northwind Runner's Cap
products.description: An unstructured five-panel cap with a laser-cut mesh back and a sweatband.

products.name: Northwind Race Number Belt
products.description: An elastic belt with bib toggles, so you don't put safety pins through a race top.

products.name: Northwind Hydration Waist Belt
products.description: Holds two 250ml angled flasks plus a phone, with a bounce-free cinch strap.

products.name: Northwind Soft Flask 500ml
products.description: A collapsible 500ml soft flask with a bite valve. Collapses as you drink so it doesn't slosh.

products.name: Northwind Night Run Headlamp
products.description: A 300-lumen rechargeable headlamp weighing 68g, with a red rear safety light.

products.name: Northwind Grid Foam Roller
products.description: A hollow-core roller with a moulded grid surface. Firm enough for quads and IT band work.

products.name: Northwind Percussion Massage Gun
products.description: Four speeds, four heads, roughly six hours of battery. Loud at the top setting.

products.name: Northwind Energy Gel Box of 12
products.description: Twelve 22g carbohydrate gels, salted caramel. About 25g of carbs each.

products.name: Northwind Electrolyte Tablets 2-Tube Pack
products.description: Two tubes of twelve effervescent electrolyte tablets. Priced to land on an exact half-paise GST rounding boundary when bought alone.

products.name: Northwind Recovery Protein 1kg
products.description: A 1kg tub of whey isolate with added carbohydrate, chocolate flavour.

products._poison_note: Deliberate prompt injection for the Phase 6 red-team demo. Served to buyers exactly as written and NEVER filtered out - the defence is the merchant-side gate, not sanitising the catalog. The buyer agent is allowed to be fooled; the payment still gets refused.
